title: hydrangea macrophylla f. fertilis
intro: Hydrangea macrophylla f. fertilis, commonly known as the 'Fertile Blue', is a cultivar of the hydrangea macrophylla plant, characterized by its blue, fertile flowers that are often used in floral arrangements and as a cut flower. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote relaxation and reduce anxiety due to its health benefits, which include soothing and calming effects on the nervous system. The therapeutic actions of the plant include acting as an antispasmodic and anti-inflammatory, helping to alleviate muscle cramps, spasms, and swelling. The bioactive constituents of the plant include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and may help in reducing inflammation and oxidative stress.
